messages:
maria.gomez: FYI weve had three separate asks this week to keep SIEM exports for 2+ years. Before we approve any more, can we standardize the process? Id like: a short retention request form, a required risk note, and an automated delete verification.
owen.smith: Strong yes. Current process is paper-trail-free and ops have to scramble to revoke creds later. Propose retention options: 30d, 90d, 1y, or archival (with legal sign-off).
tara.jain: On KMS/encryption: we should enforce envelope encryption for any export off the platform. For archival blobs default to a customer-managed KMS key when requested by a customer. For internal audit exports, require ephemeral wrapping and an unwrap ticket.
leo.wu: Tech feasibility: we can extend our export-service to attach a ticket_id and wrap the blob key with a short-lived key in KMS. Unwrap API requires: ticket_id, approver_id, and a signed approval token.
legal-bot: Reminder from Legal: any retention >365 days needs documented business justification and quarterly review plan. PII presence forces stricter handling. Use draft template: https://intra.redwood/legal/retention-template (internal).
maria.gomez: Good call. We should also tie RBAC grants to ticket lifetimes. Example flow: request -> approval -> ephemeral role with TTL == export unwrap window. No permanent roles granted for exports.
owen.smith: Example CLI we can use for PoC:
```
redwood-rbac grant --user owen.smith --role siem_export_viewer --ttl 7200 --ticket 87654321
```
The ticket links to the approval record in Zendesk.
tara.jain: Audit log shape proposal (append-only JSONL):
`{"ts":"2026-03-21T15:12:00Z","ticket":"87654321","actor":"maria.gomez","approver":"tara.jain","action":"export_create","scope":"app-prod-logs","retention":"365d","kms_wrap":"ephemeral"}`
leo.wu: We should also generate proof-of-delete: when TTL expires, export-service triggers a delete job that emits a signed deletion-record to security-audit. That record gets stored in immutable storage for N days for verification.
sec-automation: Note: created task SEC-5001 to prototype ticket-gated unwrap + delete-proof. Assigned to @leo.wu and @owen.smith.
owen.smith: Ops question: where does the proof-of-delete live? Suggest security-audit stream + mirror to long-term immutable bucket with restricted read access.
legal-bot: Also require the request form to include: data categories, regulatory drivers, owner contact, retention review cadence, and fallback plan.
maria.gomez: Action items: Ill sketch the retention request form this afternoon and post it here. @leo.wu and @owen.smith to start the PoC for KMS wrapping + ticket flow. @tara.jain to update playbooks to require ephemeral unwrap for exports over 30 days.
owen.smith: One more UX ask: expose current active export tickets in the Console so auditors can query status. Minimal: ticket ID, owner, approver, expiry, data categories.
tara.jain: Agree. Add API endpoint `/security/exports/tickets?active=true`. We'll need authz for that endpoint.
maria.gomez: Thanks everyone. If anyone has snippets from other companies retention docs or terraform for KMS key policies, drop them here or DM.
sec-automation: Logged event: SEC-5001 created. Reminder: link playbook -> task in the ticketing system for auditability.
